parserRefactorRegressions.note: Dedicated IJSVGSwitch node, C transform-origin tokenization using the shared length parser, C language matching, and spread-method utility reuse. MDN counts above remain from the last full corpus run.

embeddedSVGRegressionSuites.note: Renderer, WebKit image controls, and image export suites passed again after limiting viewport clipping to slice. The external SVG slice control uses an equivalent inline viewport because WebKit applies meet to that external image.

markerAndOverflowRegressionSuites.note: Nested viewport defaults, scroll and clip overflow, visible slice overflow, marker paints and clipping, and export round trips are covered. The raster visible overflow control passed on rerun using an equivalent full size reference image because WebKit clips the original despite visible overflow.

displacementRegressionSuites.note: Numerical tests cover source interpolation in both color spaces, named and implicit inputs, missing input fallback, and chained displacement results. WebKit controls cover all 16 channel pairs in both color spaces and embedded image maps with and without viewBox. Equivalent flood regions verify linear image maps because WebKit does not linearize the embedded map in the direct comparison.

lightingRegressionSuites.note: Diffuse and specular spotlight cones match WebKit at 5.5, 10, and 40 degrees. Flat surfaces at heights 1 and 15 match equivalent lowered point lights. Point and spot light samples remain stable across render scales 1 and 3.

lineCapRegressionSuites.note: Final renderer, command parsing, bounds, visibility, export, filter batching, and explicit WebKit cap controls passed after recording definite nonzero subpaths during C parsing. Ambiguous and changed geometry still uses the point subpath scan. The MDN square cap is the expected difference. Checks include degenerate curves, multiple subpaths, parser cache hits, mutable path edits, copies, replacement, dashed points, gradient paint, rotated caps, non scaling strokes, and export round trips.
